name: 98663 · Vancouver, WA
findings: ZIP 98663 (Vancouver) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98663 (Vancouver) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98663 (Vancouver) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
